proof_body:
by
  classical
  intro α _ _ _ i W
  have heq : ∀ a b : α, (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ i = a)).card = (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ i = b)).card := by
    intro a b
    refine Finset.card_equiv ((Equiv.refl α).equivCongr (Equiv.swap a b)) ?_
    intro f
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Equiv.equivCongr_apply_apply, Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.refl_apply]
    constructor
    · intro h; rw [h, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
    · intro h
      have := congrArg (Equiv.swap a b) h
      rwa [Equiv.swap_apply_self, Equiv.swap_apply_right] at this
  have hsum : ∑ a : α, (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ i = a)).card = (Fintype.card α).factorial := by
    rw [← Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_perm]
  have hX : Fintype.card α * (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ i = i)).card = (Fintype.card α).factorial := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => heq a i), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul] at hsum
    exact hsum
  have hW : (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ i ∈ W)).card = W.card * (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ i = i)).card := by
    have hm : ∀ σ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ i ∈ W), σ i ∈ W := fun σ hσ => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hσ).2
    rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hm]
    have : ∀ w ∈ W, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ i ∈ W)).filter (fun σ => σ i = w)).card = (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ i = i)).card := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← heq w i]
      congr 1
      ext σ
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      constructor
      · exact fun h => h.2
      · exact fun h => ⟨h ▸ hw, h⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
  have hcα : (Fintype.card α : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hf : ((Fintype.card α).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero _
  rw [hW, div_eq_div_iff hf hcα, ← hX]
  push_cast
  ring
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] (i : α) (W : Finset α), ((Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm α => σ i ∈ W)).card : ℝ) / (Fintype.card α).factorial = (W.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card α
